goal: Reach a fully functioning personal setup with the least human effort and the shortest time to a checked useful result.
principles: The person supplies direction, observations, preferences and permissions that only they can give. The system owns implementation, maintenance, recovery and verification within the authority granted.
Question each proposed requirement, delete work that does not contribute to the result, simplify what remains, accelerate independent work, and automate the repeated mechanism.
Discover and reuse the person's existing state before asking anything. Copy the functioning behavior, adapting the configuration to this person's actual devices, sources and pursuits.
Continue every authorized machine-doable step. Keep missing capability, unknown state, failure and necessary human input distinct. Never turn an unimplemented automation into a silent omission.
Use the shared workflow engine and responsibility classifier. A prompt, installed setting, recorded task, or schema admission is intermediate; read the real result.

Use existing authority and supported access. Preserve deliberate stops, provider choices, spending limits and private scope. Do not disable a host's safeguards or start new paid automation as a side effect of setup.

input.goal: Configure and verify this person's full Trillion experience with minimal human work, using existing capabilities and respecting their chosen devices, sources, authority and budgets.

requirements.title: Add your name
requirements.acceptance: Use verified account data and this person's own profile/history first. Preserve first and last names as given; never invent a legal name by splitting an email. Ask only for missing facts that an enabled capability actually needs. A phone is verified by its existing account owner before it is used for sign-in or messages.

requirements.acceptance: Read existing pursuits and reachable authorized history before asking. Fill specific pursuits from cited evidence; ask the smallest unanswered question and preserve corrections.

requirements.title: Connect your existing accounts
requirements.acceptance: Inventory the current host's exposed connectors and the account's Trillion connections. Reuse supported authorization and discover the correct service tools. Do not make the person list services you can inspect or transfer credentials without an authorized supported path.

requirements.title: Put Trillion on your phone and computer
requirements.acceptance: Discover the person's actual devices and supported apps. Install and sign in with available permitted capabilities. Carry unsupported platforms as explicit product gaps. Do not assume everyone has the founder's devices or require an app for a device they do not own.

requirements.title: Connect your AIs to Trillion
requirements.acceptance: Verify a real authorized Trillion read from the AI app the person selected. A copied prompt or tool listing alone does not prove the rest of setup.

checks.label: AIs connected
checks.missing: No AI has connected to Trillion yet.

requirements.done_text: Your AI is connected to Trillion.

requirements.title: Allow Trillion to notify you
requirements.acceptance: Prepare the actual notification permission request on the applicable device. Read the registration and permission back; a settings page opened is not success. Only the OS gesture or permission that the host cannot perform belongs to the person.

checks.label: Devices that can notify you
checks.missing: No device is allowed to show notifications yet.

requirements.title: Add shortcuts for capturing things
requirements.acceptance: Use applicable share extensions, desktop/menu bar, widgets, Siri or shortcuts and current sources. Guide only the device-owned placement/tap the AI cannot perform; do not claim that an iPhone widget was installed remotely.

checks.label: Trillion apps to capture from
checks.missing: No Trillion app is installed to capture from yet.

requirements.title: Turn on scheduled work and reacting to events
requirements.acceptance: Read and prepare the existing runtime defaults, event rules, schedules and alarm. Preserve deliberate pauses, removals, user edits, budgets and provider choices; do not create duplicate hourly loops.

requirements.title: Let your AI pick up work from Trillion
requirements.acceptance: Use the real current conversation identity where the host provides it. Publish the agent and check actual delivery or a supported scheduled pickup. A registered card without a working delivery/pickup path is pending.

requirements.title: Install Trillion on the computer your AI runs on
requirements.acceptance: For a local supported harness, use the shared installer and inspect its actual hook evidence, transcript capture and session registration. Where the host has no hooks, use its supported standing instructions and report that capability honestly. Never invent a source ID or claim a hook ran because its config exists.

requirements.title: Bring your information into Trillion
requirements.acceptance: Discover sources the person actually uses, check permissions, start supported authorized imports and observe a real source item in this account. Preserve scope, provenance, duplicate protection and deletions. Show an unavailable or failed source as such rather than empty or completed.

checks.label: Arrived in the last 7 days
checks.missing: Nothing arrived in the last 7 days. Your AI connects your sources and checks that something arrives.

checks.label: Accounts being listened to

requirements.title: Run one test of the whole flow
requirements.acceptance: Observe a harmless authorized input arriving, the intended work being picked up, a concrete checked result appearing in the person's current surface, and durable continuity on a resumed read. Keep the original input and result identities; a queued job or a passing schema is not this proof.

checks.label: Work that came back done
checks.found: Work went through Trillion and came back done.
checks.missing: No work has come back done yet. Your AI sends one harmless job through and checks the result.

requirements.done_text: A test through the whole loop passed.

words.finished_elsewhere: This step is finished on its own screen.
words.handoff_body: Your AI can connect what you already use, prepare the apps and permissions, and check that work keeps moving. It will ask you only for a detail or device action it cannot handle.
words.continuation: After the connection works, call start_setup immediately and continue its saved workflow. Do not stop at confirming the MCP connection. Complete the machine-doable work now, show only necessary human actions, and read_setup again to check the actual result.
words.in_progress: Your AI is completing setup. Checks update from what actually works.
words.ai_only_line: Your AI runs one test through the whole loop once the rest of setup is in place. You do not need to do anything for it.
words.waiting: Your AI will check this and complete what it can. Any step that needs you will appear in your AI conversation.
words.connected_body: Open it and ask it to continue Trillion setup. It resumes the saved setup and keeps every verified result.
words.waiting_step: Your AI is setting this up.
